purpose: Real model chooses tool calls from spoken intent; no injected function calls or prerecorded actuator frames.
input_mode: Explicitly labelled synthetic speech for repeatability; does not prove user microphone capture.
execution_rules: Use one real connected physical device and normal advertised capabilities.
Wait for each command terminal receipt before proceeding; accepted is not success.
Do not retry a failed physical action automatically; inspect it and preserve the result.
Return only a short spoken conclusion; show technical diagnostics as text.
Check no user call or controller is active before starting.
Record device simulated=false, command outcomes, ordered numeric frame summaries and response audio duration.
Cleanup stops remaining motion, restores neutral face and lights off, and releases control.
